scope: Targeted delivery review prompted by specialized school names. School names identify research leads, not automatic whole-school assignments. Corrects language-pathway versus campus participation classification; preserves school/program identities, separate language records, allocations, population models, assessments and original observations.
temporal_policy: New delivery adjudications apply to 2025-26 only. The source retains its original undated description and actual 2026 capture date. No historical allocation, operation or tested-cohort exposure is inferred.
delivery_definition: A campus can be a whole-school DL model with multiple partner-language pathways. Strand delivery requires participation by only part of the campus; separate language pathways alone do not establish an English-only general education pathway.
